question: Adopt the exact accepted-parent Stage C directional/nonlocal design as the proposed contract, without authorizing implementation or execution?

options.summary: Adopt the reviewed design and retain the implementation and execution boundaries.
options.consequence: The exact parent identities, inventories, routes, model hierarchy, diagnostics, adverse controls, verification contract, and proposed resource envelope become the authoritative proposed Stage C calculation design; no code or calculation is authorized.

options.summary: Do not adopt the proposed design.
options.consequence: Retain the design records as proposed work and await specific correction or disposition instructions.

recommendation: ADOPT_EXACT_ACCEPTED_PARENT_STAGE_C_DESIGN because the adversarial review reports NO_BLOCKING_FINDINGS after corrections, every represented convention and inventory is explicit, parent preprocessing and model errors remain separate, and implementation and execution stay closed.
safe_scope: Adopt only the exact design, protocol, preflight, and adversarial review as the proposed accepted-parent Stage C contract; synchronize Task, documentation, checksums, and Harness projections without implementing or executing it.
blocked_scope: Execution-free implementation, accepted-parent reads by new Stage C code, calculation, execution, Stage B reruns, Stages D and E, material-specific DFT, production Wannier90, scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, material transfer, publication, release, deposit, external transmission, commit, and push remain unauthorized.
authorized_scope: Adopt only the exact accepted-parent Stage C design, protocol, preflight, and adversarial review as the authoritative proposed contract; synchronize bounded Task, documentation, checksum, and Harness state; stop without implementation, accepted-parent reads by new Stage C code, execution, commit, push, or successor activation.
